an10.11:1.1: [sāvatthiyaṃ] pañcaṅgasamannāgato bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ senāsanaṃ sevamāno bhajamāno na cirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya,
an10.11:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an10.11:2.3: ‘iti pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an10.11:2.4: appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya.
an10.11:2.5: asaṭho hoti amāyāvī, yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvīkattā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārisu.
an10.11:2.6: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an10.11:2.7: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an10.11:2.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
an10.11:3.2: idha bhikkhave senāsanaṃ nātidūraṃ hoti nāccāsannaṃ gamanāgamanasampannaṃ
an10.11:3.5: tasmiṃ kho pana senāsane viharantassa appakasireneva uppajjanti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā.
an10.11:3.6: tasmiṃ kho pana senāsane therā bhikkhu viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā,
an10.11:3.7: te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati:
an10.11:3.9: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañceva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañca uttānīkaronti. anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhānīyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
an10.11:3.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave senāsanaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ hoti.
an10.11:3.11: pañcaṅgasamannāgato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ senāsanaṃ sevamāno bhajamāno na cirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññāsacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti.
